notes: Partition verified: 26 source and 29 target ids each once.

s003 καί left unrepresented under rule 65's English-side test is right — the ASV writes though for the concessive and no word for the intensifier. A reference comparison will report it as a disagreement and that report is not a correction.
s012 εἰμι is an expressed copula and takes am directly, so rule 53's supplied-copula question does not arise; the inverted subject I rides inside as an ordinary helper.

The ASV's reordering of εἰς Χριστὸν πίστεως ὑμῶν into of your faith in Christ is handled under rules 15 and 25 with each token independently recoverable; s022 is unrepresented because the second ὑμῶν is free to take your.
